decisions.reason: As a single construction-site dumper with weaker fit to the firm's more specialized lifting and underground niches, it looks like a peripheral option whose market potential should be sufficiently learned by 2022 to justify redeploying resources if traction has not become clear.

A multi-model inclined furniture-lift line fits the firm's lifting, customization and service capabilities well, so the option value of staying in this niche likely still exceeds the relatively manageable cost of keeping it available.

The inclined building-material-lift line appears closely aligned with the firm's construction and lifting applications and offers scope for service and model variation, making continued commercialization the more likely choice.

The truck-mounted inclined furniture lift is adjacent to the lift business but adds vehicle-integration complexity and likely serves a narrower niche, so after several years the firm would be somewhat more likely to exit if results have not clearly validated the concept.
